summary_1line: Angada recounts the lineage of the monkey kings and explains Rama’s alliance with Sugriva after Bali’s death while addressing the doubtful vulture Sampati.

image_candidates.scene_text: The weakened vulture Sampati is helped down from a mountain peak by a circle of wary monkeys who sit prepared to fast to death.
Jatayu battles Ravana in the sky, shattering the demon king’s chariot while Sita struggles in Ravana’s grasp.
Rama solemnly performs the funeral rites of the fallen vulture Jatayu in the forest.
